candidates.snippet: Ukraine's Air Force says Russia has launched 410 drones today so far, with 336 shot down. https://t.co/miUdgUOQhg

The Ukrainian Navy says the first-ever battle between unmanned sea drones took place in the Black Sea. During the fight, Ukraine’s Sargan 3000 USV shot up and sank a Russian sea drone. https://t.co/qwQoB7J0xq
